parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 2
parts.instructions: Read the three texts about a trip to a castle. For each question, choose the correct answer.

persons.name: Ella
persons.text: We had a picnic outside in the castle garden, and then we went on a tour of the inside. That was my favourite part of the day. We had to do some schoolwork too, of course! We wrote down information and took photos for a project. We didn't really have enough time at the castle, so I think I'll ask my parents to take me again.

persons.name: Carole
persons.text: The teacher asked us to sit in the garden of the castle and draw a picture of it when we arrived. My friends all said that was really boring, and I agreed. After that, we had a tour of the inside. I didn't think anyone lived in castles any more, but there's still a family living in this one. That's amazing!

persons.name: Tina
persons.text: Before our visit we wrote down some questions about the castle, and had to find the answers while we were there. It made the day more interesting. We walked around some of the rooms in the castle, but I had more fun in the garden, taking pictures with my new camera. They look really brilliant on my bedroom wall.

items.question: Who is happy with the photos she took at the castle?
Who found out something which surprised her?
Who wants to return to the castle?
Who didn't like the school work she had to do?
Who preferred seeing the outside of the castle to the inside?

parts.title: Listening Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: Our Hollywood tour for young people is called Hollywood Living. Join us for an exciting day <u>on July 23rd</u>. We also have an adult tour on July 25th.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: To join the tour, please <u>be at our office at 6000 Hollywood Boulevard</u>, ten minutes before the start. Hollywood Boulevard is home to some famous Hollywood cinemas – what we in America call movie theaters. We'll visit the Dolby Theater at 6801 Hollywood Boulevard and the Chinese Theater next to it.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: After that it will be time for lunch and <u>we'll go to Lucky Devil's Restaurant for burgers</u>. We might see somebody famous there, but most of the stars prefer to eat salads and other healthy food in Beverly Hills.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: In the afternoon, <u>we'll take a tour of the stadium where California's best basketball team plays</u>, and you'll watch one of their games. Sorry, we don't have tickets for baseball or football games.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: This young person's tour costs <u>$27 for under 16s</u>, and $37 dollars for any adults that come along too. Book your place now!

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 6
parts.instructions:
Yesterday, you went shopping in your town. Write an email to your English friend, Zoe. Say:
- who you went with
- what you bought
- what you did after shopping.
Write 25 words or more.
parts.prompt:
From: Zoe

Yesterday, you went shopping in your town. Write an email to me!

Say:
- who you went with
- what you bought
- what you did after shopping

checklist.band5: All three questions are answered clearly and with relevant detail.
checklist.band3: Two questions answered, or answers lack detail.
checklist.band1: Only one question answered or content is mostly irrelevant.

checklist.band5: The email is well-organised with a greeting, clear answers and a sign-off.
checklist.band3: Some organisation but may lack greeting/sign-off or answers are not clearly separated.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Hard to follow.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer:
Hi Zoe,
Yesterday I went shopping with my mum. We went to a clothes shop and I bought a new T-shirt and some jeans. After shopping, we had lunch at a café near the park.
See you soon!

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 2
parts.instructions: Read the three texts about a tour of the Morgan car factory. For each question, choose the correct answer.

persons.name: Narith
persons.text: Last Saturday, I had my first visit to the Morgan car factory. I don't know why I didn't think of going before, because our town is not far from Malvern, where the factory is. I'm so glad my parents gave me and my friend factory tour tickets as a present. What a brilliant two-hour tour! The morning we went was nice and sunny, which was lucky because we had to walk outside a lot. I want to come back in the future and drive one of the cars.

persons.name: Toby
persons.text: I love cars, especially old cars, so I was really excited about going to see where Morgans are made. It's quite a long way from my home, and I can't drive, so my cousin Leo gave me a lift and I bought both our tickets. He isn't interested in cars. But even Leo thought the tour was amazing, so you don't have to like cars to enjoy the tour. They use both old and modern ways of working, which taught me a lot about machines and engineering.

persons.name: Marlon
persons.text: The tour started with a very good ten-minute information film, and then we walked around the factory. We had a tour with a guide for two hours, but couldn't see some of the outside parts of the factory because there was a thunderstorm. We watched people building the cars, and when I stopped and asked them questions, they didn't mind. I'm going to get a really good job when I'm older, so I can get a Morgan sports car.

items.question: Which person says he learned many things from his visit?
Which person would like to buy a Morgan car in the future?
Which person visited the factory with someone that does not like cars?
Which person had good weather during their visit to the factory?
Which person spoke to the people that make the cars?
Which person did not have to buy tickets for the tour himself?
Which person lives quite near the factory?

parts.title: Listening Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: The Branton Museum of Pop Music is the city's most popular museum for visitors aged 12 to 18. Its new location in Victoria Square is much more central than its old Green Street address.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: This month, it has a new exhibition called <u>'Scoresound', that's spelled S-C-O-R-E-S-O-U-N-D</u>, and it explores film music, with hundreds of pictures, recordings and videos. It's open from the 31st of October until <u>the 25th of November</u>.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: The museum's also just opened a new fashion room. Here, you can see <u>the clothes worn by some of the most famous pop stars</u> of the last 50 years.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: You can travel to the museum by car or bus, and you get <u>a free poster</u> with your entrance ticket.

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: Museum tickets for adults cost eight pounds fifty, but for schoolchildren up to the age of 19 it's just <u>five pounds seventy-five</u>. However, children under five go free.
